analysis.policy: Use complete valid adjacent pairs only; keep every failure/noise row. Compare paired ratios and raw spread across all four workloads and both loops. Do not infer allocation counts, a stock-Uvicorn gain, other systems, or statistical confidence from these descriptive summaries.
analysis.retention_decision: requires review against the frozen plan; no automatic speed claim
analysis.scope: normal release candidate reuse versus fresh allocations on this recorded hosted runner only
analysis.source_identity_policy: Every executable runtime source hash must match the checkout snapshot or installed Python dependency ledger before and after each sample. The non-executable py.typed marker is bound by the clean Git revision and selected parity receipt, not sampled as executable code.

decision_rule: retain only a repeatable named-metric gain beyond matched control variation with no material guard regression; otherwise reject/remove; do not infer allocations from throughput
limitations: One noisy pair is excluded without replacement. All 80 invocations and failures remain in the hosted archive.
Descriptive comparison on this Linux x86-64 runner only; no allocation count, statistical confidence, stock-Uvicorn gain or other-system claim.
The nonexecuting py.typed marker is checked in both wheel payload audits and source/parity identity; the per-sample executable ledger does not record it.
Final removal selected installed-wheel parity and strict source/native audit passed 13/13. Full final-source CI/coverage/review and three-system measurements remain required.
rationale: Mixed upload gains are retained, including lower CPU/request in all five asyncio 1 KiB-write pairs.
The small-response uvloop guard has worse p95 and CPU/request in all four accepted pairs, and lower throughput in three of four.
The frozen rule requires repeatable gain without material guard regression; reject instead of tuning or selecting only favorable cells.
removal_contract: Fresh bounded chunk allocation after reserving queue capacity; 64 KiB read bound; queue capacity two.
Preserve partial chunks, ordered data/EOF/errors, reset/cancellation/half-close behavior and explicit ReadBuf copy.
Remove the returned-buffer channel as well as recycling. The measured fresh control retained that channel, so its timings do not measure this final removal binary.
